title: Anze Sun Presents "SoK: The Cryptanalysis of SHA-3 Standard" at ACISP 2026
description: The paper SoK: The Cryptanalysis of SHA-3 Standard was accepted by ACISP 2026, where graduate student Anze Sun presented the work at the conference.
